Definition: from G1722 and βιβάζω (to mount; causative of G1684); to place on, i.e. transfer (aboard a vessel):--put in.
BiblicalUsage: embibázō means put in. In Acts 27:6, the text says "and he put us therein."
TheologicalSignificance: Out of embibázō I do not force more than it gives: put in.
